tasks.subject: Clone repo and check out v1.0.15 baseline
tasks.description: Clone https://github.com/shisa-ai/jouzu-desktop into F:/devAI/jousu-desktop-nsh, branch port/nsh from tag v1.0.15. Install nsh CLI.

tasks.subject: Design NSH port architecture and scaffold the app
tasks.description: Read nsh docs (rust, mixed apps, native modules, windows). Decide app layout: NSH app replacing Tauri shell, Rust backend crate reusing src-tauri logic, TSX UI. Scaffold with nsh init and verify it builds/runs headless (nsh test) on Windows.

tasks.subject: Port Rust backend from Tauri to NSH native modules
tasks.description: Move src-tauri business logic (sessions, chat_process, runtime, artifacts, attachments, etc.) into the NSH app crate, replacing tauri commands/events/AppHandle with NSH native module functions and event delivery. Keep tauri-free logic intact where possible.

tasks.subject: Port React UI to NSH TSX screens
tasks.description: Port launcher UI (React 19 + radix + tailwind) to NSH TSX with signals: launcher page, workspace selection, chat workspace, panels, composer, settings/system sections. Markdown rendering via Rust module if needed.

tasks.subject: Verify ported app: nsh check, nsh test, nsh run
tasks.description: Type-check, run headless tests, and launch the app on Windows. Document remaining gaps honestly.
